title: 民用無人機電池安全
summary: 以「把無人機電池能量、電流、熱與狀態估算分開」為主線，在不接真實電池的合成BMS資料工作台中依序完成可用能量與任務預算、導線內阻的熱量、散熱路徑及熱阻、溫度量測的時間延遲、BMS異常判讀的誤警及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Separate drone-battery energy, current, heat and state estimation in a Synthetic BMS-data bench without a physical battery, progressing through Usable energy and task budget, Internal and wiring resistive energy, Cooling path and thermal resistance, Temperature-measurement timescale, False alarms in BMS anomaly interpretation, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 可用能量與任務預算：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Usable energy and task budget: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 可用能量與任務預算 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Usable energy and task budget and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「民用無人機電池安全」中，本單元處理「可用能量與任務預算」。標稱能量需乘可用分率，再以平均功率估續時；尖峰供電與熱限制要另查。
steps.instructionEn: Within Civil-drone battery safety, this unit examines Usable energy and task budget. Nominal energy times usable fraction gives an energy budget; duration uses average power, while peak-current and thermal limits need separate checks.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：標稱能量 E=600 Wh、可用分率 u=0.75、負載 P=300 W。關係式 t=Eu/P；含輸出單位換算的算式 600*0.75/300，結果 1.5 h。適用範圍：固定平均負載與可用分率；不是可執行任務的飛行時間保證。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Nominal energy E=600 Wh, usable fraction u=0.75 and load P=300 W. Relation t=Eu/P; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 600*0.75/300 gives 1.5 h. Applicability: Fixed mean load and usable fraction; not a guaranteed operational flight time.
steps.failure: 在「可用能量與任務預算」的情境中，把Ah直接當Wh會漏掉電壓，也忽略電壓隨荷電狀態變化。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Usable energy and task budget, Treating Ah as Wh omits voltage and its variation with state of charge.
steps.check: 針對「可用能量與任務預算」，分別列巡航、感測、通訊和返航預留能量，核對同一Wh基準。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Usable energy and task budget, List cruise, sensing, communication and return reserve on the same Wh basis. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 可用能量與任務預算
knowledge.text: 在「民用無人機電池安全」中，本單元處理「可用能量與任務預算」。標稱能量需乘可用分率，再以平均功率估續時；尖峰供電與熱限制要另查。
knowledge.textEn: Within Civil-drone battery safety, this unit examines Usable energy and task budget. Nominal energy times usable fraction gives an energy budget; duration uses average power, while peak-current and thermal limits need separate checks.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 P 改為450 W，其餘條件固定。用 600*0.75/450 重算，結果從 1.5 變成 1 h。先預測方向，再記下對「可用能量與任務預算」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only P to 450 W, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 600*0.75/450: 1.5 becomes 1 h. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Usable energy and task budget, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

steps.objective: 辨識 用電需求與轉換效率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Electrical demand and conversion efficiency and its observable causal relationships.
